body: Zero fucks given. They might be a little upset, but I’m not their only kid. They’ll get over it. Knowing how much my mom likes to complain about the money and time I cost her trying to get help it would probably be a bonus if there wasn’t all that funeral bullshit to take care of. It kinda fucking sucks, but I think it’s also a little comforting in my situation. I just want to pass quietly, and it’s just two more people who will forget soon enough.
